intent_contract.text: 시각 의미 데이터화 후보팩에 반영해줘. 그 다음 독립된 서브에이전트 3개에서 각각 서로 다른 컨셉으로 첨부한 이미지를 활용하여 랜덤한 복잡한 컨셉을 정해서 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성하도록 하여 잘 반영되었는지 테스트해줘.

Create and render one independently randomized, visually complex photographic concept that uses the supplied image only to guide the facial appearance of an original adult woman, then evaluate whether the composed visual semantics survive into the pixels.

Create a photorealistic full-length environmental portrait of an original adult woman whose facial appearance follows the supplied reference image, while the character, body, wardrobe, and world remain original. She is a cloud-forest storm-keeper performing a wind-calibration operation at violet predawn in a canopy observatory grown through colossal strangler-fig roots. Seen from a three-quarter rear view, she braces her boots on a rain-dark root catwalk, turns her face naturally into view, and threads a luminous liana through a bronze tension ring to recalibrate a living storm compass. Her fully closed waxed-nettle work coat is belted over layered storm trousers, with practical gloves and high boots. Electrically charged fog advances through the canopy as the first rain bends fern vanes and agitates suspended gauge bells. Show wet fig bark, aged bronze verdigris, translucent vine tissue under tension, and one amber work lantern against cool moss glow. Keep the hand-to-vine-to-ring mechanism readable and the full working silhouette clear.
